sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'Aramex' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.id) FROM customers cu JOIN orders o1 ON o1.customer_id = cu.id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.customer_id = cu.id WHERE o1.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o1.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date < '2026-01-01'

SELECT e.name, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'
SELECT AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Qahtani Trading Est.'
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON e.city_id = c.id WHERE e.role = 'support_agent' AND c.name = 'Tabuk'

SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING AVG((julianday(t.closed_at) - julianday(t.opened_at)) * 24) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = t.customer_id) >= 2)

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

WITH rev AS (SELECT (CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3 AS q, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q), ref AS (SELECT (CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3 AS q, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q) SELECT 'Q' || rev.q AS quarter, ROUND(COALESCE(ref.refunds,0) / rev.revenue, 4) AS refund_ratio FROM rev LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.q = rev.q ORDER BY COALESCE(ref.refunds,0) / rev.revenue DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Riyadh')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.id) FROM customers cu JOIN orders o1 ON cu.id = o1.customer_id JOIN orders o2 ON cu.id = o2.customer_id WHERE substr(o1.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o2.order_date, 1, 4) = '2026'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'product_question' AND closed_at IS NULL

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.id = r.order_item_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE substr(o2.order_date,1,7) = substr(o.order_date,1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = o2.id)) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

WITH items AS (SELECT oi.id AS item_id, CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_date < '2025-10-01' THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS q, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'), rev AS (SELECT q, SUM(rev) AS revenue FROM items GROUP BY q), ref AS (SELECT i.q, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM items i JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = i.item_id GROUP BY i.q) SELECT rev.q AS quarter, ROUND(COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0) / rev.revenue, 4) AS refund_ratio FROM rev LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.q = rev.q ORDER BY COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0) / rev.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM cities c JOIN customers cu ON cu.city_id = c.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'SMSA' AND shipped_at >= '2024-01-01' AND shipped_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'bank_transfer' AND paid_at >= '2024-07-01' AND paid_at < '2024-10-01'

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST(COUNT(r.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h1_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h1_2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' AND NOT (o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01') GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT region_name FROM rev WHERE h1_2024 > 0 ORDER BY (h1_2025 - h1_2024) / h1_2024 ASC, region_name LIMIT 1
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON e.city_id = c.id WHERE e.role = 'account_manager' AND c.name = 'Makkah'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ct ON ct.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ct.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Asir' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'wholesale'

SELECT c.segment FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY CAST(SUM(t.units) AS REAL) / COUNT(o.id) DESC, c.segment LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(MAX(p.unit_price), 2) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Snacks'
SELECT re.name FROM regions re JOIN cities ci ON re.id = ci.region_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.city_id = ci.id WHERE cu.segment = 'enterprise' GROUP BY re.id ORDER BY COUNT(cu.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at < '2026-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01')

SELECT 'Q' || q AS quarter FROM (SELECT ((CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3) AS q, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev, SUM(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r WHERE r.order_item_id = oi.id),0)) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY q) ORDER BY ref / rev DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) > 0 ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01'

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), cust_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca JOIN cust_orders co ON co.customer_id = ca.customer_id CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ca.avg_hours > o.avg_hours AND co.order_count >= 8
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Fahad Al-Anazi'
SELECT COUNT(p.id) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Personal Care' AND p.active = 1

SELECT m.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS team_revenue FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, m.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ci.name FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(oi.discount_pct) AS mean_discount FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Stationery'
SELECT COUNT(p.id) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Stationery' AND p.active = 1

SELECT COUNT(ci.id) FROM cities ci JOIN regions re ON re.id = ci.region_id WHERE re.name = 'Hail'

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'damaged_item' AND closed_at IS NULL

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT region_name, ROUND((rev2025 - rev2024) * 100.0 / rev2024, 2) AS growth_pct FROM rev WHERE rev2024 > 0 ORDER BY (rev2025 - rev2024) * 1.0 / rev2024 ASC, region_name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'cash' AND paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND paid_at < '2025-04-01'

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0050'

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE substr(o2.order_date,1,7) = substr(o.order_date,1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = o2.id)) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), cust_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg c JOIN cust_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id WHERE c.avg_h > (SELECT avg_h FROM overall) AND o.n >= 5

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM cities c JOIN customers cu ON cu.city_id = c.id JOIN support_tickets st ON st.customer_id = cu.id WHERE substr(st.opened_at, 1, 4) = '2024' AND st.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(st.id) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ct ON ct.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ct.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01'

WITH r AS (SELECT rg.id, rg.name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h2_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h2_2024 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions rg ON rg.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY rg.id, rg.name) SELECT name FROM r WHERE h2_2024 IS NOT NULL AND h2_2024 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(h2_2025, 0) - h2_2024) / h2_2024 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

SELECT m.name AS manager, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS team_revenue FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, m.name LIMIT 3

SELECT r.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND ((o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01') OR (o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01')) GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END), 0) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1

SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) >= 3 AND (SELECT AVG((julianday(t.closed_at) - julianday(t.opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND t.closed_at IS NOT NULL) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)
